Yes Product description Product Description HG Mould Spray is a fast-acting black mould remover for walls and household surfaces affected by visible mould, mildew, fungus and algae in damp areas. Its targeted, self-acting spray has a bleaching action and works in around 30 minutes, helping remove stains without scrubbing on compatible surfaces. Use it indoors in bathrooms, showers, toilets, kitchens, cellars, basements and saunas on suitable plastered walls, tiles, grout, silicone joints, window frames and other compatible surfaces. It can also be used outdoors around compatible swimming pools, facades, balconies, plant boxes and garden ornaments, excluding wood. One 500ml bottle treats approximately 2–3 m² of wall surface or 6–8 m² of tile grout. Ensure good ventilation and wear suitable rubber or plastic gloves. Remove the safety clip or unlock the nozzle. Spray from approximately 3–5cm away and leave for 30 minutes. Clean the treated area with water and a sponge. For stubborn stains, reapply and leave for a further 30 minutes. For silicone joints, wash off after 30 minutes and repeat if necessary. Always test first in an inconspicuous area. Permanent brown discolouration may occur on elastic grouting, badly glazed tiles or old tiles with hairline cracks. Do not use on wood, coloured surfaces, ceilings, clothing, paintwork, plastic shower trays, vertical blinds, aluminium, stainless steel or other sensitive metals. Avoid splashes and do not reuse the bottle. Never mix with other cleaning products, as dangerous chlorine gas may be released. Wash hands after handling. Store and transport cool, dark and upright. Very toxic to aquatic life; avoid release into the environment. Keep out of reach of children and read the label before use. Full content visible, double tap to read brief content. A Game-Changer for Tackling Mould—Highly Effective! Having tried countless mould sprays over the years, this is the only one that has truly delivered exceptional results. It’s incredibly effective and has saved me time, money, and effort in both my home and work life. I’ve used this spray on silicone sealant that I thought would require expensive replacement due to dark black mould spots. To my surprise, just a couple of applications completely eradicated the mould! For very deep, dark, or large areas of mould that have penetrated the sealant, multiple applications may be necessary, but even then, the mould fades significantly. This product works wonders not just on bathroom and kitchen sealants but also on discoloured grout, window frames and seals, skirting boards, backs of furniture (with care—always test a small area first and avoid soaking expensive or varnished items), and bathroom/shower walls and ceilings. While it’s not officially recommended for painted surfaces, I’ve successfully used it on white emulsion-painted areas without any issues—no scrubbing required! I typically spray generously and leave it overnight for best results. For tougher mould spots, a second or third application might be needed. The spray does have a strong chemical odour similar to bleach, so proper precautions are essential. I recommend wearing a mask and goggles (especially if spraying higher areas like ceilings) and ensuring the room is well-ventilated by opening windows. With common-sense safety measures in place, it’s easy to use effectively. As someone who works in property management and deals with over 20 properties annually that have condensation-related mould issues, this product has been a lifesaver. It allows me to resolve mould problems quickly and efficiently. We also use it routinely between tenancies to clean bathrooms—grout, sealant, and ceilings—saving significant time compared to scrubbing grout with bleach or replacing sealant altogether. In my own home, I used to replace the shower sealant every 12–18 months due to mould buildup. Since using this spray, the sealant looks like new and stays fresh for years! Regularly spraying as soon as mould spots appear prevents the need for multiple applications and makes one bottle last an impressively long time. I’ve only deducted one star for minor reasons: the product takes several hours to work its magic (so patience is required), multiple applications may be needed for severe mould cases, and the odour can be quite strong when working with large areas. Additionally, while the safety catch above the trigger is a bit fiddly, it’s an essential feature for child safety. The internal tube now needs inserting before first use—it’s slightly inconvenient but helps prevent damage from long-term chemical exposure if stored unused for extended periods. Overall, this product is nothing short of amazing. It’s transformed how I deal with mould at home and in my work. If you’re looking for an effective solution to tackle stubborn mould problems without breaking the bank or spending hours scrubbing, I highly recommend giving this a try! I picked up this Tapo L530B colour bulb not expecting much given the price, but it’s actually been a really solid addition and great value for money. Setup was straightforward through the Tapo app and linking it with Alexa only took a couple of minutes. Since then it’s been reliable with no dropouts, which is always my main concern with smart stuff. Brightness is more than enough for a main room light and it dims nicely through the app or voice control. Just worth knowing it won’t work with a traditional dimmer switch, so it’s better on a standard on/off. The colours are better than I expected as well great colour temperature range. The whites go from a warm cosy tone to a cooler brighter light, and the colours are strong enough to actually notice without looking cheap or washed out. In day to day use it’s very responsive. Commands through Alexa are pretty much instant and it reconnects quickly if it’s been turned off at the wall. Only small downside is the usual smart bulb thing where if someone turns it off at the switch, you lose control until it’s turned back on again, but that’s not really a fault with this one specifically. Overall, it just works. Easy to set up, reliable, and does exactly what you’d want from a smart bulb without spending a fortune. Compatible with Alexa and google home. The Atari app oddly takes up a lot of storage space if this is a premium for you but does work very well And easy to navigate. Setting the under cabinet lights on motion sensor mode, it features a 120° wide sensing angle and a 3M/10FT detection distance, automatically turning off after 20 seconds of no motion detected, ensuring you never fumble for switches. Adjustable 3-Color Temperature & 5-Brightness: Equipped with 3 color temperatures: warm (3000K) for cozy spaces, cool (6000K) for task lighting, and balanced mixed (4500K) for versatile use. Easily switch between modes with a one-touch temperature button and creates a sense of atmosphere. Setting the brightness levels from 10%, 25%,50%, 75%, to 100%, or A long press activates stepless dimming, meets different lighting needs. It features a brightness/color temperature memory function. 4 Lighting Modes: The motion sensor lights support four modes to meet the needs of different occasions: OFF Mode, Night Sensing Mode (motion-activated in darkness), Daytime Sensing Mode (motion-activated at any time whether the environment is dark or not) and Always on Mode (constant light). The auto-sensing functionality ensures optimal lighting utilization, making it ideal for kitchens, closets, cupboards, pantries, stairs, basement and other spaces needing reliable lighting. USB-C Rechargeable & Long-lasting: Built-in 1800mAh high-capacity battery, it offers up to 8 hrs in high brightness mode and lasts 7-45 days in sensor mode. It can be easily recharged by the type-C cable, no need to charge frenquently. It's the perfect choice for upgrading your home lighting! (2 USB-C cables included). Ease of Installation & Wide Usage: With built-in strong magnets, these cabinet lights can be easily installed on iron surfaces. For non-metallic surface, you can use the included adhesive iron plates to stick on anywhere you want, which means that it's easy to take off and put back on when it needs a charge. It is a good choice for various occasions including kitchen, bedroom, closet, cabinets, counter, pantry, basement, stair, hallway, shelves, etc. › See more product details Additional details Verified by Transparency The brand applies a unique Transparency code to each item. " Read more " Small and tears very easily " Read more View Image Gallery Amazon Customer 5.0 out of 5 stars Images in this review Reviews with images See all photos Previous slide Next slide All photos Amazon Customer 5 out of 5 stars Comfortable, True-to-Size Gloves That Don't Tear Easily I've tried quite a few disposable gloves over the years for various jobs, including DIY, maintenance work, and more 3D resin printing, and these have impressed me more than expected. Sizing is often an issue with disposable gloves, as many of the cheaper ones I've bought in the past tend to come up smaller than advertised. An XL can sometimes fit more like a Large. Thankfully, these are true to size. The XL fits me perfectly, with no tight spots and no excess material at the fingertips, making them comfortable to wear while still allowing good dexterity. The gloves strike a nice balance in thickness. They're not the thickest nitrile gloves I've used, but they're certainly not flimsy or paper-thin either. They provide a reassuring level of protection while still allowing enough finger sensitivity for detailed tasks. One thing I particularly like is how much stretch they have. They slide on easily and stretch well without immediately tearing, which is something I've experienced with cheaper gloves in the past. My main use for these has been 3D resin printing, where reliable hand protection is essential. During several printing sessions, I had no issues with resin penetrating the gloves, and they held up well while handling resin-coated parts. They gave me confidence that my hands were properly protected throughout the process. Being powder-free and latex-free is another plus, especially for anyone with latex sensitivities or who simply prefers gloves that don't leave residue behind. They're comfortable enough to wear for extended periods and don't have an overpowering chemical smell when first opened. Considering the fit, durability, comfort, and level of protection they provide, I think these offer excellent value for money. They perform exactly as I'd hoped and compare favourably with gloves that cost considerably more. Once this box is finished, I'll happily buy another. " Read more View Image Gallery Amazon Customer 5.0 out of 5 stars Images in this review Reviews with images See all photos Previous slide Next slide All photos Amazon Customer 5 out of 5 stars Reliable, low-odour litter that keeps things clean and simple I’ve been using the 20L Catsan Hygiene Plus litter for a while now, and it’s a solid, no-fuss option if you want something clean, simple, and effective. The biggest strength is the absorbency and odour control. The granules act like a sponge, locking in moisture quickly before smells develop, which really helps keep the litter tray fresh between full changes. It also uses a mineral protection system that reduces ammonia odours, so it doesn’t get unpleasant too quickly. Another thing I like is that it’s unscented and made from natural materials (quartz and limestone), so there’s no artificial fragrance masking smells just straightforward hygiene. That makes it a good choice if your cat is sensitive or picky about scented litter. The low dust is also noticeable when pouring it into the tray, which is a bonus for both you and your cat. And the white colour makes it easier to spot when it needs changing. A few downsides: It’s non-clumping, so you can’t just scoop out urine you’ll need to change the whole tray more regularly The granules can track a bit outside the tray Large 20L bag can be a bit heavy to handle Overall, it’s a dependable, hygienic litter that does exactly what it promises without overcomplicating things. Verdict: A great everyday cat litter with strong odour control and natural ingredients—ideal if you prefer non-clumping, low-maintenance options. Deep Dive into the 20L Bag of Bright White Magic If there were an award for the most sophisticated-looking cat litter, Catsan Hygiene Plus would be sweeping the stage! This isn't just a bag of pebbles; it feels like a high-end hygiene solution for the most discerning of feline housemates. The first thing that strikes you is the colour—a brilliant, snowy white that instantly makes the litter tray look more like a spa and less like, well, a toilet. Science Meets Sand The "magic" here lies in those clever little micropores. This litter is like a series of tiny sponges made from natural quartz and lime. It doesn’t just sit there; it actively seeks out moisture and locks it away before the dreaded "litter box smell" even has a chance to think about escaping. It’s incredibly impressive how dry the tray stays, maintaining a fresh environment for much longer than standard clay alternatives. There is nothing worse than filling a tray and being greeted by a grey cloud that settles on everything in a five-mile radius. Catsan is remarkably clean-burning—err, clean-pouring. It’s a massive win for anyone who values a tidy home and a clear airway! Is It a Marathon Runner? In terms of longevity, the 20L bag is a beast. It’s the gift that keeps on giving. Because the mineral protection is so effective at neutralising odours, you aren't constantly rushing to dump the whole tray. While it is non-clumping (so you only scoop the solids), the overall hygiene levels stay surprisingly high throughout the week. Final Thoughts If you are looking for a reliable, aesthetically pleasing, and ultra-absorbent litter that treats odour control as a serious mission, this is the one. Ideal for laboratories, food service, clean rooms, and janitorial tasks, these gloves offer reliable protection in any environment. What are Nitrile gloves? Nitrile gloves are disposable protective gloves made from a synthetic rubber material known as Nitrile. They are widely used in various industries, including healthcare, due to their durability and protective properties. What are the advantages of using Nitrile gloves? The benefits of Nitrile gloves include:-High puncture resistance -Excellent chemical resistance -Latex-free, reducing the risk of allergic reactions -Good tactile sensitivity -Strong, durable, and suitable for medical use Are Nitrile gloves safe for individuals with latex allergies? Yes, Nitrile gloves are an ideal alternative for individuals with latex allergies. They do not contain natural rubber latex, which eliminates the risk of allergic reactions. Can Nitrile gloves be reused? Nitrile gloves are typically designed for single-use. While some may remain intact after multiple uses, reuse is not recommended as it may compromise the glove's integrity, reducing its protective effectiveness. Can Nitrile gloves be used for food handling? Yes, Nitrile gloves are suitable for food handling, provided they are labeled as food-safe or comply with relevant food safety standards in your area. I've three cats who all love Felix cat food sachets. In my opinion, it's a superior brand. I'm physically disabled with limited dexterity, and even I find the sachets extremely easy to open. The contents slide out of the sachets into the bowl, meaning you don't have to squash it out with your hands. The pieces of food look meatier than any other cat food brand, and there's just a fine layer of jelly. In the past, I've found my cats would eat the jelly and leave the meat. With these Felix sachets, they lick the dish clean. Each sachet holds the perfect amount to feed my three cats two sachets each a day. They have dried food too as they like a variety. Unlike other brands, there's barely any smell from this food. When I've put the food down at night and the cats go out without eating it, it doesn't dry up. They'll happily eat it when they come back in the morning. I rehomed a black cat whose fur was far from soft, but several months of eating Felix cat food shed got a lovely soft coat. None of my cats have ever been sick after eating Felix, unlike other food sachets which they were constantly throwing up. So it's obviously good for their digestion. One of my cats gets up onto my workbench and sits, staring at the cupboard. I keep the food in and won't budge until he's fed. That's him in the photo waiting on his food. I usually feed him separately as the two girls tend to budge in and eat his food too. My cats love it. They lick their dishes clean, and they'd definitely recommend it.
